body.statement: Two directed acyclic graphs on the same finite vertex set entail exactly the same d-separation relations if and only if they have the same undirected skeleton and the same unshielded collider triples.

source.locator: Section 2, Markov equivalence and latent-DAG recovery setup

attestation.note: Stable arXiv carrier supplied for the standard skeleton-and-unshielded-collider characterization used to turn a faithful conditional-independence pattern into a latent Markov equivalence class.
